Control header claims originals are used 'for representation only', yet imports semantic (executing s_domain profile construction, importing q_audit) and calls d.q.incoming/sign machinery — heavier than pure representation, though no reducer step/check executes.
findings: Implement treats retained rows/prefixes as optional: case.get('rows') or [] / case.get('prefixes') or [] (o17-staged-source-implement.py:322), silent early return at :121-122, row=None fallback at :360, no length requirement. A case missing both keys still reaches 'supported' (:366-378) once state-derived witness classes fire; control requires len(rows)==n-1 and len(px)==n (o17-staged-source-control-build.py:91-94) — same evidence gives opposite verdicts. Fixture: valid case minus 'rows'/'prefixes'. Fix: require both inventories or force 'unproved'.

Implement's journal mirror covers only MIRROR's 4 fields with untyped != (:31,:108) and filters the certificate list to MIRROR before comparing (:131-133); the original relation diffs all s_domain.EXTRA+source_generation (12 fields) under typed exact() (adapter_traces.related, semantic.exact). Divergence in 'collection'/'attempts'/'source_revision' and bool-int or list-tuple type confusion in mirrored fields is undetected; non-MIRROR cert entries are silently dropped. Fixture: journal source_revision True vs source 1. Fix: diff all 12 fields via _typed, compare unfiltered.

Implement trusts the retained q_profile instead of re-deriving the fixed subprofile (:348-353; 'if qp is not None' skips entirely when absent), where adapter_traces.restore pins exact(qp, subprofile(profile)); a forged/absent q_profile defeats the invocation-mask check. Also .index() at :343/:350 raises ValueError, missing from the caught types at :362 — malformed evidence crashes inspection rather than recording failure. Fix: recompute subprofile via the literal source_only filter, require equality, catch ValueError.

Identity-proof verification is split inconsistently: control binds cited origin digests to replayed states but accepts any in-range real event — not necessarily a stage event, nor the last-unchanged-stage origin identity_audit defines (control-build:75-82); implement requires index==recomputed _origin (:139-153) but never verifies the proof's digest fields, and _identical (:67-71) omits signed()/payload binding, expecting 'original-object-identity' on forged equal-bytes staged objects where identity_audit yields 'unrelated'. Interop: run_controls over implement leaves 3/8 controls undetected (prefix-certificate-dropped, journal-diff-falsified on rows[].differing_journal_fields it never reads, causal-pair-event-shifted on unaudited incarnation_pairs).
